unmatched_gold.text: The operator revised its policy during the later response.

pairs.gold_text: Yelverton Minerals and mines inspectorate met during the later response.
pairs.system_text: Yelverton Minerals and the mines inspectorate met on 2026-03-19 to discuss the landslide.

pairs.gold_text: Ashfell slide damaged the lower road.
pairs.system_text: The Ashfell slide damaged the lower road in Dreth and Withel, with damage also reported in the bench area.

unmatched_gold.text: Damage was reported in Dreth and the Pellan during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: The lower road was restored during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: The lower road was restored by 2026-03-19 at 12:16, with confirmation from government and NGO sources.

pairs.gold_text: Service at Corvane mine was disrupted during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: Service was disrupted in the Ashfell bench, upper bench, and at Corvane mine and the pit, with additional disruptions reported at the lower road.

unmatched_gold.text: Service at the lower road was disrupted during the Ashfell slide.

pairs.gold_text: 60 households were displaced from Cranmoor during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: 60 households were displaced from Cranmoor, as reported by government and media sources.

pairs.gold_text: About 60 households were evacuated from Withel terraces during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: About 60 households were evacuated from Withel terraces, and people were evacuated from Cranmoor and the Ashfell bench, including the upper bench.

unmatched_gold.text: People were evacuated from Ashfell bench during evacuation and displacement operations.

unmatched_system.text: Information was provided about the pond and Corvane tailings dam, and the company revised its policy following the landslide.

pairs.gold_text: A warning was issued for Withel terraces and Cranmoor during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: A warning was issued for the Withel terraces and Cranmoor on 2026-03-14 at 07:24.
